stage_2_story.text_en: It was a rainy Saturday afternoon, and Avi decided to take his two children to see the new blockbuster that everyone at school was talking about. He bought three tickets at the counter and let each child choose a snack. His daughter picked a small popcorn, while his son went straight for a giant one. Before the main film, they watched a trailer for an exciting sequel to another movie they had loved last year. When the film began, Avi was grateful that the cinema offered subtitles in Hebrew — the cast spoke quickly and used a lot of slang. The director had done a wonderful job mixing action with humour. At the end, the children clapped and immediately asked if there would be another sequel. On the way home, they argued cheerfully about which genre they would choose next time — his daughter wanted a comedy, but his son was already dreaming of the premiere of the next superhero film.
